items.q: Do you remove all sizes of filing cabinets?
a: Yes, we remove all filing cabinet sizes from compact personal units to large lateral cabinets. Our team handles standard letter/legal sizes and oversized specialty cabinets with equal expertise.

items.q: Can you remove heavy or metal filing cabinets?
a: Absolutely. Our professionals are equipped to remove heavy-duty metal filing cabinets, including fireproof and security models. We use proper tools to safely handle these weighty items.

items.q: What areas do you serve for filing cabinet removal?
a: We service the entire Greater Toronto Area, including Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, and surrounding areas. No location in the Greater Toronto Area is too far for our team.

items.q: Do I need to empty my filing cabinet before pickup?
a: Yes, please remove all contents beforehand. Our crew will handle the empty cabinet itself, including any required disassembly or special handling for removal.

items.q: How much does filing cabinet removal cost?
a: Costs vary by size or quantity, but most standard 4-drawer units start from 125$ to remove. We provide free exact quotes with no hidden fees.
